title: Built-in pack skills never install for consumers — pack-ctl passes no sourceRoot
description:
RE-SCOPED 2026-07-29 (human-approved). This ticket was minted from a TASK-180 review MEDIUM about `watch` dual-copy precedence. The investigation invalidated that premise and surfaced a larger, already-shipped defect in its place. See the `orchestrator` comment for the original scope and the evidence that killed it.

**The real defect: Wave-1 skill reconcile is inert for every consumer project.**

`src/pack-orchestrator.js#reconcilePack` documents `sourceRoot` as defaulting to `<repoRoot>/assimilated-skills` (see its JSDoc, and `src/pack-apply.js`'s own default). `bin/pack-ctl.js`'s `reconcile-apply` branch calls `reconcilePack({ repoRoot, descriptor, profileResult, owner })` and NEVER passes `sourceRoot`. In the framework repo that accidentally works, because the repo root genuinely holds `assimilated-skills/`. In a consumer project it cannot: the owned copies live in the PLUGIN, not in the consumer's repo.

Reproduced live against a clean fixture project (PROJECT.md only) using the installed plugin's own `dist/pack-ctl.cjs`:

```
PLAN install: [ 'skill:ui-ux-pro-max', 'skill:watch' ]
design-power | installed: 0 | 'owned source not found for "ui-ux-pro-max": <consumer>/assimilated-skills/ui-ux-pro-max'
watch        | installed: 0 | 'owned source not found for "watch": <consumer>/assimilated-skills/watch'
```

Both built-in packs plan the install correctly and then soft-fail at materialize. `installed: 0`. Because the failure is `required: "soft"`, it degrades silently into `report` and the CLI still prints `ok: true` — so the command LOOKS successful.

Blast radius beyond `watch`: `/hivemind:design-pack`'s headline promise (installing `ui-ux-pro-max`) has never worked for any downstream consumer. TASK-180 fixed the `watch` symptom by bypassing the pack path entirely; nothing fixed the path itself.

**Fix direction:** resolve the plugin/framework root and pass it as `sourceRoot`. Precedent already in-repo — `src/claude-settings.js:33` (`CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` env var first) and `bin/brain-launch.js:26` (`[CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, cwd]` fallback chain). The resolver must work in BOTH launch modes: `bin/pack-ctl.js` run from the framework repo, and the bundled `dist/pack-ctl.cjs` run from a plugin cache directory. It must NOT regress the framework-repo case that works today.

Second, independent defect to fix here: a soft `owned source not found` is reported but the command still exits 0 with `ok: true`, which is how this stayed invisible. Surface it so a consumer can tell that nothing was installed.

Deferred, NOT in scope: the original dual-copy precedence question. Once this fix lands a consumer CAN hold both `.claude/skills/watch/` and the plugin's `skills/watch/`, so that question becomes live again — mint it separately.
acceptance_criteria: A failing spec first reproduces the defect: reconcile-apply against a consumer-shaped root (no assimilated-skills/ of its own) reports 'owned source not found' and installs 0 skills. Capture the red-run output verbatim as the tests-first evidence.

bin/pack-ctl.js resolves the plugin/framework root and passes it through as sourceRoot, so a built-in pack's owned copy is sourced from the PLUGIN rather than from the consumer's repo root. Resolution follows the existing in-repo precedent (src/claude-settings.js:33 CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT-first, bin/brain-launch.js:26 fallback chain) rather than inventing a new mechanism.

The resolver works in BOTH launch modes, each covered by a spec: (a) bin/pack-ctl.js executed from the framework repo, and (b) the bundled dist/pack-ctl.cjs executed from a plugin-cache-shaped directory with no node_modules. Neither may depend on process.cwd() being the plugin root.

End-to-end proof against a clean consumer fixture (PROJECT.md only, no assimilated-skills/): reconcile-apply materializes .claude/skills/watch/ with SKILL.md + scripts/ present and provenance intact, and installed length is non-zero. The same fixture must ALSO install skill:ui-ux-pro-max when the design profile activates it — watch alone is not sufficient proof.

The framework-repo path does NOT regress: reconcile-apply run with --repo-root pointed at the hivemind repo itself still resolves owned copies and still no-ops on already-installed skills (steady state stays a no-op, not a reinstall loop).

A soft 'owned source not found' no longer presents as an unqualified success: the CLI surfaces that zero resources were installed despite a non-empty install plan, so a consumer can tell the difference between 'nothing to do' and 'everything failed'. Covered by a spec asserting the distinguishable output.

Copies materialized into a consumer project are byte-identical to the plugin's owned copy (same invariant tests/watch-skill-parity.spec.js enforces in-repo) — the fix must not introduce a rewrite-on-copy path that breaks the provenance pin.
npm run test:all is green; no existing pack/reconcile/assimilate/apply spec regresses; dist/pack-ctl.cjs rebuilt via npm run build:plugin and committed, with tests/e2e/dist-parity.spec.js passing.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body:
RE-SCOPED on human approval (2026-07-29). Recording the original scope and the evidence that killed it, so the pivot is auditable.

## Original scope (now void)
"Define precedence when a pack resource is ALSO shipped at plugin root (watch dual-copy)" — minted from a TASK-180 review MEDIUM. Premise: a consumer that ran `pack-ctl reconcile-apply` holds `.claude/skills/watch/` (as `/watch`) while also receiving the plugin's `skills/watch/` (as `/hivemind:watch`), and the two silently diverge on the next release that re-pins watch.

## Why the premise is false
The project-scope copy is UNREACHABLE for a consumer, so two copies can never disagree. `reconcilePack` defaults `sourceRoot` to `<repoRoot>/assimilated-skills` and `bin/pack-ctl.js:410` never overrides it — in a consumer project that path does not exist, so the install soft-fails at materialize.

Reproduced against a clean fixture (PROJECT.md only) using the installed plugin's own `dist/pack-ctl.cjs`:

```
PLAN install: [ 'skill:ui-ux-pro-max', 'skill:watch' ]
design-power | installed: 0 | 'owned source not found for "ui-ux-pro-max": <consumer>/assimilated-skills/ui-ux-pro-max'
watch        | installed: 0 | 'owned source not found for "watch": <consumer>/assimilated-skills/watch'
```

Both packs plan correctly, then install nothing. This also means the guidance given earlier in the session — that a consumer could get `watch` by running `reconcile-apply` — was wrong; that path has never worked downstream.

## What replaces it
The defect above, which is strictly larger and already shipped: Wave-1 skill reconcile is inert for every consumer, so `/hivemind:design-pack`'s headline promise (installing `ui-ux-pro-max`) has never worked for anyone downstream. TASK-180 fixed the `watch` symptom by bypassing the pack path; nothing fixed the path.

Compounding factor folded into this ticket: the failure is `required: "soft"`, so it degrades into `report` while the CLI still prints `ok: true`. The command looks successful, which is why this went unnoticed through at least two releases.

Tier stays `tdd` — this is state-mutating reconciler/apply logic with real edge-risk, and the fix must not regress the framework-repo path that currently works by accident.

## Still open, deliberately deferred
The original precedence question becomes live again once this lands, because a consumer will then genuinely be able to hold both copies. To be minted separately rather than smuggled back into this ticket.

comments.author: reviewer
comments.body:
REVIEW VERDICT: **APPROVE** — light depth (human override; rubric said full, see prior orchestrator comment). Range reviewed: `bc585e3..66ee5d9`. 0 HIGH / 2 MEDIUM / 1 LOW.

## AC1 red-run evidence — INDEPENDENTLY REPRODUCED (this is the load-bearing record)
The developer hand-off was lost with the session, so no captured red-run existed. The reviewer reproduced it in an isolated scratchpad extraction of base commit `bc585e3` (shared tree never touched): consumer fixture with PROJECT.md only, design profile activating ui-ux-pro-max, running the PRE-FIX `bin/pack-ctl.js reconcile-apply`:

- Plan: `install: [skill:ui-ux-pro-max, skill:watch]` (non-empty)
- `installed: []` for BOTH packs
- `owned source not found for "watch": ...\consumer-red\assimilated-skills\watch` — sourced from the CONSUMER's root, which is the precise defect
- `ok: true`, exit 0 — the unqualified-success masking that AC6 targets

Same fixture against the FIXED CLI, cwd deliberately outside the repo: `planned: 2, installed: 2`, with `watch/scripts/` and `ui-ux-pro-max/` materialized on disk. Fails for the right reason; matches the commit message's claim verbatim. Tests-first invariant proven behaviorally.

## Per-AC verdicts
AC1 MET (by reviewer reproduction) · AC2 MET (`src/plugin-root.js` CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT → running-file ancestors → repoRoot, per the claude-settings.js / brain-launch.js precedent; threaded at `bin/pack-ctl.js:429-436`) · AC3 MET (both launch modes spec'd; grep across all four touched impl files finds `process.cwd` only in a comment — no code path uses it) · AC4 MET (clean-consumer e2e installs BOTH skills) · AC5 MET (framework-repo no-op holds; applyPlan Set-dedupe prevents double-probing when repoRoot IS the plugin root) · AC6 MET (`ok:false` + planned_install_count/installed_count) · AC7 MET (Buffer.equals byte-identity + pin assertion; cpSync, no rewrite-on-copy) · AC8 PARTIAL — `dist/pack-ctl.cjs` verified freshly machine-built and byte-matching a fresh esbuild; a clean `test:all` was not producible in-tree due to TASK-175's concurrent uncommitted churn (see below).

## Gate results
`npm run test:since -- bc585e3` → 7 spec files (non-zero), 93/93 PASS · `npm test` → 76 files, 1025 passed / 2 skipped PASS · `tests/e2e/pack-ctl-consumer-source.spec.js` (6) + `tests/e2e/pack-ctl.spec.js` (24) PASS · `tests/e2e/dist-parity.spec.js` → 1 failed / 1 passed.

**The dist-parity failure is explicitly NOT charged to this ticket.** The drifted bundle is `dist/init.cjs` only; `dist/pack-ctl.cjs` byte-matched a fresh build. The reviewer proved the committed state is clean by rebuilding from an isolated extraction of the base commit and normalizing esbuild path comments — committed `dist/init.cjs` is byte-identical to a rebuild from committed sources. The drift exists solely in the working tree, from TASK-175's concurrent uncommitted edits to `bin/init.js` / `src/backlog-seeder.js`.

## Vacuous-sensor claim (verified)
The old `a_soft_skill_missing_its_owned_source...` test WAS vacuous — it relied on its fixture's silence, a precondition no consumer has and which the fix now legitimately fills from the plugin. The replacement (`tests/e2e/pack-ctl.spec.js:247-266`) forces a genuinely unreachable source via `HIVEMIND_OWNED_SOURCE_ROOT` (candidate 0, returned verbatim, outranks every fallback), preserves the original invariant and strengthens it. Non-vacuous: if the override were ignored the plugin fallback would install and the `existsSync(...)).toBe(false)` assertion would fail.

## Precedence (search-path change) — holds in code
`src/pack-apply.js#applyPlan`: `searchPath = [...new Set([sourceRoot, ...(sourceRoots || [])].filter(Boolean))]`. `sourceRoot` defaults to `<root>/assimilated-skills` and callers pass the plugin root only via `sourceRoots`, so a consumer's own staging dir always leads — a local adoption still beats a built-in of the same id. `executeInstall` resolves first-existing-match PER RESOURCE, so a partially-populated staging dir falls through per-skill rather than winning wholesale.

## Findings
**MEDIUM-1** [`bin/pack-ctl.js:90-95`] — the header's documented output contract ("`{ok:true,...}` on success (exit 0) or `{ok:false, code, message}` on failure (exit 1; message also to stderr)") is now FALSE for reconcile-apply's total-failure path, which this diff made emit `ok:false` with **exit 0** and **no** `code`/`message`. A consumer scripting against the documented contract will mis-parse the exact failure mode AC6 exists to surface. Fix: update the header's output-contract paragraph.

**MEDIUM-2** [process] — no developer hand-off exists (session lost), so neither the AC1 red-run evidence nor the agility-R3 pre-hand-off checklist outcomes were verifiable from artifacts. Reproduced independently (above), so not a blocker; this comment is the durable record that MEDIUM-2 asked for.

**LOW-1** [`tests/e2e/pack-ctl.spec.js:89-91`] — `runCli` deletes `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` but not `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT`, while the new consumer-source spec's `runCli` deletes both. Harmless today; a future test depending on fallback order could flake under a plugin-session environment. Fix: mirror the env hygiene of `tests/e2e/pack-ctl-consumer-source.spec.js:70-74`.

Calibration sweep: reviewed range touches no epistemic-marker files — N/A. Minimalism: new module small, single-purpose, precedent-following; no gold-plating.
